command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "578281bf750d7c86792ba4d6ccde505a7678c01f"
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-audit5-venv-XXXXXX)
DATA=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-audit5-data-XXXXXX)
STORAGE=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-audit5-storage-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$VENV" "$DATA" "$STORAGE"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$STORAGE/private" "$STORAGE/public"
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
cd backend
PHOTOMAP_DATA_DIR="$DATA" PHOTOMAP_STORAGE_DIR="$STORAGE" ADMIN_TOKEN=dev-admin-token CLAIM_TOKEN_SECRET=audit-claim-secret "$VENV/bin/python" -m pytest -q
cd ..
git status --short
